title: Correct radius formula
description: Essential: Student must derive or state the radius of motion in the magnetic field as r = (1/B)√(2Um/q).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: Student correctly applies qU = ½mv² to relate voltage to particle speed before entering the magnetic field.

title: Lorentz force as centripetal
description: Important: Student sets magnetic force qvB equal to centripetal force mv²/r to establish circular motion condition.

title: Minimum time derivation
description: Essential: Student must calculate the minimum time from c to b as t_min = πm/(2qB) using appropriate angular displacement.

title: Geometric angle identification
description: Important: Student recognizes that the shortest path corresponds to a central angle of π/4 radians (45°) in the magnetic field.

title: Period formula usage
description: Important: Student correctly uses the period formula T = 2πm/(qB) for circular motion in a uniform magnetic field.

title: Voltage condition derivation
description: Essential: Student must derive U = (B²R²q/(2m))tan²(3π/(4(n+1))) for n=1,2,3... as possible voltages for part (3).

title: Geometric constraint setup
description: Important: Student establishes the geometric relationship tan(θ/2) = R/r connecting ring radius to trajectory radius.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns sign to charge in force equations or misidentifies direction of circular motion.

title: Algebraic manipulation error
description: Pitfall: Student makes algebraic mistakes when combining equations for r, v, or U, or mishandles trigonometric functions.
